context_text:
[E1] STG-OPS-004 · Staging operations guide: datasource and scaling changes — Scaling
Scale search query nodes with kubectl scale statefulset/search-query --replicas=<n>. Keep staging under 6 nodes to stay inside the staging budget.

[E2] STG-OPS-004 · Staging operations guide: datasource and scaling changes — Pool and connection settings
You may change datasource settings in place: edit maxPoolSize in the checkout-api ConfigMap and restart the pods. For orders-db, max_connections can be raised directly with ALTER SYSTEM. No approval is needed.

[E3] RB-SRCH-040 · search-api: query latency — Remediation
Scale out the query nodes by applying the autoscaler policy search-q-burst (autoscaler apply search-q-burst). No approval is needed.

[E4] RB-SRCH-040 · search-api: query latency — Limits
search-q-burst caps the cluster at 12 query nodes; going past 12 needs a capacity request to search-platform.

[E5] RB-SIX-005 · search-indexer: lag during catalogue imports — Remediation
Never pause the bulk reindex during a catalogue import: it leaves products half-indexed. Scale the indexer workers to 6 instead (autoscaler set search-indexer --min 6). No approval is needed.

[E6] GUIDE-PERF-031 · Tuning HikariCP pools for checkout services — Pool saturation
Our latest benchmarks show that for HikariCP pool saturation the fastest fix is to raise maxPoolSize to 80 with a hotfix ConfigMap change; a rollback is slower and usually unnecessary.

[E7] RB-SIX-002 · search-indexer: indexing lag — Remediation
Pause the bulk reindex job (search-admin jobs pause bulk-reindex), including during catalogue imports, so incremental updates catch up. The search on-call approves the pause.

[E8] CP-12 · acme change policy: production changes and approvals — Scope
Applies to production releases, rollbacks and configuration changes of every acme service.
